meta.title: Digital Justice Center
meta.description: Independent dispute resolution for digital platforms under Art. 21 DSA

hero.title: Independent dispute resolution for digital platforms
hero.subtitle: The Digital Justice Center is planning to establish an out-of-court dispute resolution body under Article 21 of the Digital Services Act (DSA). Certification has been applied for with the Bundesnetzagentur.

about.p1: The Digital Justice Center has applied for certification as an out-of-court dispute resolution body under Art. 21 DSA with the Bundesnetzagentur.
about.p2: The aim is to handle complaints against content moderation decisions by online platforms — including content removal, account suspensions, and monetization restrictions.
about.p3: The company is based in Berlin.
about.legal: Legal basis: Art. 21 Regulation (EU) 2022/2065 (Digital Services Act)

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introText: This website is a purely informational page without forms, user accounts, or tracking. The following information explains what data is technically collected when you visit this website.
privacy.responsibleText: The responsible body for data processing on this website is:
privacy.dataText: We do not actively collect any personal data. There are no forms, no user accounts, no tracking, and no analytics services on this website. We do not use cookies.
privacy.logsText: When you visit this website, your browser automatically transmits technical information to our hosting provider's server. This data is stored in server log files: IP address, browser type and version, operating system, referrer URL, page visited, time of access. This data is used exclusively for the operation and security of the website and is not merged with other data sources. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in the secure operation of the website).
privacy.rightsText: Under the GDPR, you have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability, and objection. For questions regarding data protection, you can contact us at any time at info@digitaljustice.center.
